hypotheses: When the judge raises questions for the owner, the agent asks all of them at its next chance to ask, even mid-task, through the question tool, grouping those that hinge on one principle into one question whose answer settles them; there is no limit per turn and nothing is kept for a later turn.

given the judge raises five questions while the agent is in the middle of a task, when the agent can next ask, then all five are asked through the question tool before the task goes on; none waits for a later turn
given twelve questions are raised and eight of them hinge on two principles, when they are asked, then the owner gets the two principle questions and the four others, six in all, in one go
given the owner answers a principle question, when the judge reads the questions that hinge on it, then those questions are settled from the answer and not asked
given the owner dismisses a question, when the turn ends, then it is not asked again in a loop; the band and the session start count it as waiting

given the judge raised a question in the background after the agent last ran the clarify check, when the agent is about to end its turn, then iaso stops it once and tells it to ask the waiting questions now; it asks them through the question tool before the turn ends, and a later turn is not stopped again for the same questions

given judge questions are open and the agent has not asked them, in a session the owner attends, when the agent tries to edit a file or run a shell command that writes, then iaso refuses it and tells the agent to ask the questions now through the question tool; reading files and read-only commands, and putting the questions in the owner's words or pushing one back, stay allowed

given the ask gate holds, when the agent calls the question tool, whether the owner answers or dismisses, or the call comes from a subagent or a run nobody attends, then the gate opens and the work goes on; a question raised later closes it again until that one is asked

given the ask gate holds, when the agent runs the clarify check it names in any spelling (the project's Python, a Windows path, after a change of folder, piped into a filter) or writes a scratch file outside the project to word a question, then iaso lets it through; only edits to the project and shell commands that write wait

given the ask gate holds in a session that began before the plugin update, when the agent asks the questions through the question tool, whether the owner answers or dismisses, then the gate opens as in a fresh session, so the owner is never asked the same question twice
